topography.project_purpose: Insurance. Structurally: 155 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 45 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs, 2 Chainlink feeds; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20permit, eip712, erc20detailed). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
